name: Winter's Presents
summary: In Ironforge, revelers gather for the Feast of Winter Veil. They direct travelers to Greatfather Winter beside the Smokywood Pastures stalls, where gifts wait beneath the holiday tree.

sections.title: A Season of Cheer
sections.body: Winter settles over Khaz Modan, and Ironforge fills with cheer for the Feast of Winter Veil. Revelers and holiday enthusiasts point passersby toward the decorated tree near the Smokywood Pastures vendors.

sections.title: Smokywood Pastures and Greatfather Winter
sections.body: Smokywood Pastures, a goblin enterprise, shares the season with Greatfather Winter. He greets visitors as goblin merchants remind gift recipients that festive treats and seasonal wares make gifts for friends and family.

faq.q: Who sends me to speak with Greatfather Winter?
faq.answer: A Holiday Enthusiast or a Wonderform Operator at an Ironforge PX-238 Winter Wondervolt machine invites you to visit Greatfather Winter at the decorated tree.

faq.q: Where can I find Greatfather Winter in Ironforge?
faq.answer: In Ironforge, Greatfather Winter sits beside the festive tree and Smokywood Pastures vendor stalls. He welcomes visitors of every Alliance race.

faq.q: What is the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt mentioned by the operator?
faq.answer: Goblin operators run the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt, a holiday invention that briefly disguises festival-goers as merry little holiday helpers.

faq.q: Why is Smokywood Pastures involved in Winter Veil?
faq.answer: Smokywood Pastures is a goblin merchant organization that sponsors seasonal treats, holiday novelties, and feasts across Azeroth. It joins festive spirit with seasonal commerce.

faq.q: Can Horde players do this quest?
faq.answer: No. This invitation is for the Alliance in Ironforge. The Horde celebrates Winter Veil with Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What happens after speaking to Greatfather Winter?
faq.answer: Greatfather Winter welcomes you and says he has not forgotten you. He encourages you to look at the colorful packages beneath the holiday tree.

angles.text: Ironforge gathers Alliance races for the winter season. Elves, humans, and gnomes come together to share festive cheer.
As a dwarf, you welcome travelers to the Feast of Winter Veil in the Great Forge. Lively song, warm hearth fires, and cold ale fill your mountain home.
As a gnome, you can marvel at the holiday contraptions brought in for the season. PX-238 Winter Wondervolts are operated across town.
